solutionSearchEvidence: Current Characters screen already renders the adopted multi-character picker and independently tracks normal Partner and Player roles; a second picker or store would duplicate authority.
Current board-facility runtime destroys that picker with roster.replaceChildren(surface) and forces #charName to Saasuna.
Current production-facing GAMEROAD_PARTNER_STATE.partner() exposes the selected normal Partner id, so the conversation projection can reuse the existing state instead of test-only globals.
The minimal repair is to append the conversation only while the active role is normal Partner and selected Partner is partner.saasuna, and otherwise remove only that conversation surface.
A single MutationObserver can reuse the existing rerender lifecycle by watching screen activity and roster child replacement; no new router, persistence, or gameplay rule is required.
